en-US.name: Snow Shot
en-US.releaseNotes:
# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.4.7

- Fixed screenshots sometimes failing to save to history.
- Made translated text more stable as results appear, reducing shifting and overlap.
- Start a new annotation immediately when clicking to clear the previous selection.

## Download guide

**Snow Shot** includes all features. **Mini** is smaller and includes screenshots, annotations, pinned images, image stitching, recording, and manual text recognition.

Online installers download OCR components when needed; offline installers include them. Portable ZIPs run after extraction. Most users can ignore `-update.zip`, `.json`, `.sha256`, and `-homebrew.tar.gz` files, which support updates, verification, and package managers.

## macOS quick install

Copy into Terminal; no `sudo` needed. For Mini, append `--edition mini`.

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.4.7_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
```

The installer verifies the download and signs the app locally. Follow the prompts for Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions. For Gitee downloads, replace `https://github.com` in the links or command with `https://gitee.com`.
